unverified: Whether NC republished v2.0 after DOE Program Notice 26-1 (HOMES-only, effective 2026-05-29) to drop ENERGY STAR or geotagged photos.
Whether another DOE-listed modeled tool besides Snugg Pro would be accepted.
County-level HUD AMI dollar limits are not copied here; AMI band is user-declared until an Address API lookup exists.

income.note: NC is stricter than federal HOMES: households >150% AMI are not eligible.

property.geography: North Carolina, all 100 counties per energysavernc.org

measures.note: Measures installed and invoiced must be in the Snugg Pro model. This product does not substitute for Snugg Pro.

fuel_restrictions.note: 12 months of utility bills for all fuels (HOMES page).

envelope_prerequisites.note: v2.0 lists weatherization photos and pre-existing insulation levels. No numeric ACH50 floor is copied here because it is not in the retrieved NC table.

modeled_savings.note: NC modeled pathway, minimum 20% predicted savings. This product is not DOE-approved and does not compute BPI-2400 equivalent-energy percent.

multifamily_note: v2.0 Table 2 uses the same per-dwelling-unit figures if ≥50% of households in the building meet the income row. Per-building caps are not copied from a fragmented federal table.
categorical_eligibility_note: Talking points: categorical enrollment letter from the last 12 months; cards not accepted. Treat quoted talking-point bullets as medium confidence.

steps: Resident chooses HOMES, HEAR, or both
Contractor submits rebate; discount on invoice
